text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Me, on the recreation committee? 
That's, um... I wonder if I can do it 
well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I know you might not be keen on taking on 
more obligations. 
However—Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There are special sights at summer camp 
that can only be seen here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want you to step into the 
very heart of this group life. 
Without distancing your heart, I want you 
to face it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Face it head-on...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In doing so, you'll surely discover 
something new. 
Something that will be a positive for you. 
...That, I believe.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (In the end, I ended up taking it on.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Not having free time makes me gloomy... 
Air Groove should already understand that, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, if she's recommending it, 
it must be because there's something 
waiting on the other side... surely...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(And so, from that day on, 
I tried to be more mindful of spending 
time with everyone, but—)

text_block_list.name: Recreation Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Now then, as you know, we'll have a BBQ 
party on the final night of the training 
camp. 
Preparing the entertainment for that is 
our recreation committee's job.

text_block_list.name: Recreation Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Classic activities like a test of courage 
or bingo can be prepared quickly, 
but does anyone have any other ideas?

text_block_list.name: Recreation Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
...If there's nothing in particular, maybe 
we'll do bingo again this year. It was 
pretty lively last time. 
Alright, then let's go with that!

text_block_list.name: Recreation Staff
text_block_list.text: Okaay.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(What a relief... The recreation committee 
isn't going to take up that much time.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(...Wait, I'm thinking about securing 
alone time again... 
Even though I was told to face communal 
living head-on.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(From early morning until bedtime, 
living together in a large room with more 
people than usual is—)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't wiping floors on all fours when it's 
not even training quite anachronistic?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
How many days have you been saying the 
exact same thing...? 
Please just get used to it already...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Every single day just ends up feeling so 
suffocating—)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aah? Was there even a formula you could 
use for this crap? 
Man, studying during summer camp too... 
What a draaag.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Pokke, solve it quietly. 
...Excuse me, Teacher. Regarding question 
2—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (However—)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san...? That's unusual... 
You usually leave right away...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, ...yes. 
Well, I thought maybe... I'd try chatting 
a bit more with everyone...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...? 
...In that case, would you like to soak 
together for a bit...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You know the rules for beach flags, right? 
Whoever grabs that flag first wins! 
Suzuka, you're the ref!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't you forget, Pokke-kun. 
If I win, you're helping me test 
pressurized training!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, alright then... On your mark, get 
set—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ............Hey, you asleep?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm asleep.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it kinda hot today? I can't sleep! 
Let's play shiritori together. Shiritori, 
go, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Bohr magneton.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, go to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How are you holding up, Suzuka? 
It seems you've gotten somewhat used to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. Summer camp... isn't just 
about feeling suffocated. 
I feel like I'm starting to understand 
that a little."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is so kind and fun. 
Once you get used to it, group activities 
aren't so stifling, and the scenery is 
beautiful too."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "I see."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Though..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, deep down... I still find myself 
missing my time alone. 
...I'm sorry. I must seem so selfish, 
don't I?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, um... it's almost my turn for 
meal duty, so I'll be going now. 
Sorry, Air Groove."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It seems things aren't going to be that 
simple.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Hee-hee. You certainly have quite a soft 
spot for Suzuka-kun, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Wh—! Just how long have you been 
listening?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Since right around when you two started 
talking, I suppose. I've known for a while 
that a modest dilemma had arisen. 
...Right, you two?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, seeing the Silence Suzuka-san... 
suddenly try so hard to join the circle... 
did feel a bit unnatural..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"And watching you look after her with that 
worried face 24/7, anyone would figure 
something's up!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, spill it, Vice President. 
We're roommates, ain't we? If you're in a 
pinch, we'll lend you a hand."
